topic: Signing Up for the Beginner Baking Class

script.title: THE BAKING CLASS
script.scene_zh: 社區廚房 · 報名課程
script.story_hook: A new hobby starts with a beginner class.
script.intro_zh: 新的嗜好，從一堂初學課開始。
script.welcome_en: Hey, today we're at a community kitchen. Listen for class sign-up phrases.
script.welcome_zh: 嘿，今天我們來到社區廚房。留意報名課程的說法。
script.outro: And you're signed up for class. Listen again and repeat.
script.outro_zh: 課程就這樣報名成功了。再聽一次，跟著說。
script.practice_intro_en: Now let's repeat each line together.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在我們一起逐句跟讀。
script.title_quote: baking is just science you can eat
script.char_a_description: a warm woman in her fifties with a short permed brown bob, reading glasses on a chain, a floral cotton blouse, a simple long skirt, and a curvy build
script.char_b_description: a friendly man in his early thirties with curly dark brown hair, a full short beard, a crisp white chef coat, a black apron, and a tall build

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, I'd like to sign up for the baking class.
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ aɪd laɪk tə saɪn ʌp fɚ ðə ˈbeɪkɪŋ klæs/
dialogue.zh: 嗨，我想報名烘焙課。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great choice! Which one, beginner or family?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɹeɪt tʃɔɪs wɪtʃ wʌn bəˈɡɪnɚ ɔɹ ˈfæməli/
dialogue.zh: 選得好！要初學班還是親子班？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Beginner, definitely. I've never baked a thing.
dialogue.phonetic: /bəˈɡɪnɚ ˈdɛfənətli aɪv ˈnɛvɚ beɪkt ə θɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 初學班，一定是。我從沒烤過東西。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect, this class starts from zero.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɝfɪkt ðɪs klæs stɑɹts fɹəm ˈzɪɹoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 太好了，這堂課完全從零開始。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh good, um, I was worried I'd mess up.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ ɡʊd ʌm aɪ wəz ˈwɝid aɪd mɛs ʌp/
dialogue.zh: 噢好，嗯，我還擔心自己會搞砸。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Everyone messes up, that's kind of the point.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛvɹiˌwʌn ˈmɛsəz ʌp ðæts kaɪnd əv ðə pɔɪnt/
dialogue.zh: 每個人都會搞砸，這就是重點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha, that makes me feel better already.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ ðæt meɪks mi fil ˈbɛɾɚ ɔlˈɛdi/
dialogue.zh: 哈，這樣說我就放心多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It should. It runs Tuesdays, six to eight.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ʃʊd ɪt ɹʌnz ˈtuzdeɪz sɪks tə eɪt/
dialogue.zh: 應該的。上課在週二，六點到八點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tuesdays work. Do I need to bring anything?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtuzdeɪz wɝk du aɪ nid tə bɹɪŋ ˈɛniˌθɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 週二沒問題。我需要帶東西嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just yourself, but bring your own oven mitts.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst jɔɹˈsɛlf bʌt bɹɪŋ jɔɹ on ˈʌvən mɪts/
dialogue.zh: 你人來就好，但要自備隔熱手套。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oven mitts, okay, I have an old pair.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈʌvən mɪts oʊˈkeɪ aɪ hæv ən ˈoʊld pɛɹ/
dialogue.zh: 隔熱手套，好，我有一副舊的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, we don't have enough to share today.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd wi doʊnt hæv ɪˈnʌf tə ʃɛɹ təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 好，我們的數量不夠大家共用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Understood. What about an apron, do I need one?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌʌndɚˈstʊd wʌt əˈbaʊt ən ˈəpɹən du aɪ nid wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 了解了。那圍裙呢，我需要帶嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We loan aprons here, so don't buy one yet.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi loʊn ˈəpɹənz hɪɹ soʊ doʊnt baɪ wʌn jɛt/
dialogue.zh: 我們這裡出借圍裙，先別急著買。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's so nice. Um, what do you actually make?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts soʊ naɪs ʌm wʌt du ju ˈæktʃuəli meɪk/
dialogue.zh: 那真好。嗯，這堂課實際上會做哪些東西？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: First week it's cookies, then bread, then pie.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɝst wik ɪts ˈkʊkiz ðɛn bɹɛd ðɛn paɪ/
dialogue.zh: 第一週做餅乾，然後是麵包，再來是派。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, pie? I can learn to make pie?
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt paɪ aɪ kən lɝn tə meɪk paɪ/
dialogue.zh: 等等，派？我可以學會做派嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Absolutely, from scratch, including the crust.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈæbsəˌlutli fɹʌm ˈskɹætʃ ɪnˈkludɪŋ ðə kɹʌst/
dialogue.zh: 當然，從頭做起，連派皮也是。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's the part I never understand about pie.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ðə pɑɹt aɪ ˈnɛvɚ ˌʌndɚˈstænd əˈbaʊt paɪ/
dialogue.zh: 那正是我做派最搞不懂的地方。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We'll show you step by step, it's easy.
dialogue.phonetic: /wil ʃoʊ ju stɛp baɪ stɛp ɪts ˈizil/
dialogue.zh: 我們會一步步教你，其實很簡單。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, I'm sold. Is the class very big?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ aɪm soʊld ɪz ðə klæs ˈvɛɹi bɪɡ/
dialogue.zh: 好，我決定要上了。這堂課人多嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, we cap it at twelve people per week.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ wi kæp ɪt ət twɛlv ˈpipəl pɚ wik/
dialogue.zh: 不多，我們每週最多十二個人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Twelve, that's small enough to get help.
dialogue.phonetic: /twɛlv ðæts smɔl ɪˈnʌf tə ɡɛt hɛlp/
dialogue.zh: 十二個人，剛好能得到老師幫忙。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exactly, and there's an assistant with me.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪɡˈzæktli ænd ðɛɹz ən əˈsɪstənt wɪθ mi/
dialogue.zh: 就是這樣，而且我會帶一位助理。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much is the whole session, um, all weeks?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ mʌtʃ ɪz ðə hoʊl ˈsɛʃən ʌm ɔl wiks/
dialogue.zh: 整個課程，嗯，全部算下來要多少錢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's forty dollars, that covers all four weeks.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts ˈfɔɹti ˈdɑlərz ðæt ˈkʌvɚz ɔl fɔɹ wiks/
dialogue.zh: 四十塊，涵蓋全部四週。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Forty for four classes, that's actually fair.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfɔɹti fɚ fɔɹ ˈklæsəz ðæts ˈæktʃuəli fɛɹ/
dialogue.zh: 四堂課四十塊，其實很划算。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We try to keep it cheap for the neighborhood.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi tɹaɪ tə kip ɪt tʃip fɚ ðə ˈneɪbəɹˌhʊd/
dialogue.zh: 我們盡量讓社區裡的人負擔得起。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I love that. Can I just sign up right now?
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ lʌv ðæt kæn aɪ dʒʌst saɪn ʌp ɹaɪt naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 我好喜歡。我可以現在就報名嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course, fill this little form out for me.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌv kɔɹs fɪl ðɪs ˈlɪɾəl fɔɹm aʊt fɚ mi/
dialogue.zh: 當然，請幫我填這張小表格。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Name, email, um, anything medical I should note?
dialogue.phonetic: /neɪm ˈimeɪl ʌm ˈɛniˌθɪŋ ˈmɛdəkəl aɪ ʃʊd noʊt/
dialogue.zh: 姓名、信箱，嗯，有什麼醫療資訊要註明嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, list any allergies, we bake with nuts too.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs lɪst ˈɛni ˈælɚdʒiz wi beɪk wɪð nʌts tu/
dialogue.zh: 有的話請寫下過敏，我們也會用堅果烘焙。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, no nut allergies, thankfully, just dairy.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ noʊ nʌt ˈælɚdʒiz ˈθæŋkfəli dʒʌst ˈdɛɹi/
dialogue.zh: 噢，沒有堅果過敏，還好，只有乳製品。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Dairy's fine, we have butter-free options ready.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈdɛɹiz faɪn wi hæv ˌbʌɾɚ ˈfi ˈɑpʃənz ˈɹɛdi/
dialogue.zh: 乳製品沒問題，我們備有無奶油的選項。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect. Do I pay today or at the class?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɝfɪkt du aɪ peɪ təˈdeɪ ɔɹ ət ðə klæs/
dialogue.zh: 完美。我今天繳費，還是上課時再繳？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pay at the first class, cash or card's fine.
dialogue.phonetic: /peɪ ət ðə fɝst klæs kæʃ ɔɹ kɑɹdz faɪn/
dialogue.zh: 第一堂課時繳，現金或卡都行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Great. Um, can I bring a recipe book?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɹeɪt ʌm kæn aɪ bɹɪŋ ə ˈɹɛsəpɪ bʊk/
dialogue.zh: 好。嗯，我可以帶食譜書嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bring one if you like, we hand out copies.
dialogue.phonetic: /bɹɪŋ wʌn ɪf ju laɪk wi hænd aʊt ˈkɑpiz/
dialogue.zh: 想帶就帶，我們會發影本。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nice. Where do I actually go for the class?
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪs wɛɹ du aɪ ˈæktʃuəli ɡoʊ fɚ ðə klæs/
dialogue.zh: 不錯。那我實際上去哪裡上課？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Room B, down the hall, second door on the right.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɹum bi daʊn ðə hɔl ˈsɛkənd dɔɹ ɑn ðə ɹaɪt/
dialogue.zh: B 教室，沿走廊走，右邊第二個門。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Room B, got it. Should I arrive early?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɹum bi ɡɑɾ ɪt ʃʊd aɪ əˈɹaɪv ˈɜɹli/
dialogue.zh: B 教室，記下了。我要早點到嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Come ten minutes early, we'll greet you.
dialogue.phonetic: /kʌm tɛn ˈmɪnəts ˈɜɹli wil ɡɹit ju/
dialogue.zh: 早十分鐘到，我們會到門口接你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's easy. I'm really looking forward to this.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ˈizil aɪm ˈɹɪli ˈlʊkɪŋ ˈfɔɹwɚd tə ðɪs/
dialogue.zh: 那很容易。我真的很期待這堂課。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So am I, it's my favorite class to teach.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ æm aɪ ɪts maɪ ˈfeɪvɚɪt klæs tə titʃ/
dialogue.zh: 我也是，這是我最喜歡教的課。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha, well, you sound excited about it.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ wɛl ju saʊnd ɪkˈsaɪtɪd əˈbaʊt ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 哈，聽起來你也很興奮。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I am. Baking is just science you can eat.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ æm ˈbeɪkɪŋ ɪz dʒʌst ˈsaɪəns ju kən it/
dialogue.zh: 我確實很興奮。烘焙就是可以吃進嘴裡的科學。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's such a good line, can I use that?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts sʌtʃ ə ɡʊd laɪn kæn aɪ juz ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 這句話太棒了，我可以借用嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, go right ahead, everyone should hear it.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ ɡoʊ ɹaɪt əˈhɛd ˈɛvɹiˌwʌn ʃʊd hɪɹ ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 哈，請隨意用，大家都該聽聽。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, all signed. Is there a make-and-take tray?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ ɔl saɪnd ɪz ðɛɹ ə meɪk ænd teɪk tɹeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 好，都報名好了。有那種做完可帶走的烤盤嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yep, every week you take home what you bake.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛp ˈɛvɹi wik ju teɪk hoʊm wʌt ju beɪk/
dialogue.zh: 有，每週你都能把烤好的帶回家。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So I can bring my neighbors some cookies?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ aɪ kən bɹɪŋ maɪ ˈneɪbəɹz sʌm ˈkʊkiz/
dialogue.zh: 那我就可以帶餅乾給鄰居囉？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exactly, baking's better when you share it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪɡˈzæktli ˈbeɪkɪz ˈbɛɾɚ wɛn ju ʃɛɹ ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 就是這樣，分享的時候烘焙更好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'm so glad I walked in today, honestly.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪm soʊ ɡlæd aɪ wɔkt ɪn təˈdeɪ ˈɑnəstli/
dialogue.zh: 老實說，我很高興今天走進來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Me too. See you Tuesday, six o'clock sharp.
dialogue.phonetic: /mi tu si ju ˈtuzdeɪ sɪks əˈklɑk ʃɑɹp/
dialogue.zh: 我也是。那週二六點整見。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes! Should I eat before or after class?
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ʃʊd aɪ it bɪˈfɔɹ ɔɹ ˈæftɚ klæs/
dialogue.zh: 好！我該上課前吃還是下課後吃？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Eat a little, but save room, there's tasting.
dialogue.phonetic: /it ə ˈlɪɾəl bʌt seɪv ɹum ðɛɹz ˈteɪstɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 先吃一點，但要留肚子，我們會試吃。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Haha, got it, a light lunch and a big snack.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈhɑhɑ ɡɑɾ ɪt ə laɪt lʌntʃ ænd ə bɪɡ snæk/
dialogue.zh: 哈哈，懂了，午餐就吃輕一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bring your mitts, form's done, you're all set.
dialogue.phonetic: /bɹɪŋ jɔɹ mɪts fɔɹmz dʌn jʊɹ ɔl sɛt/
dialogue.zh: 記得帶手套，表格填好了，你就沒問題了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thank you, this was so easy to arrange.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋk ju ðɪs wəz soʊ ˈizil tə əˈɹeɪndʒ/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝你，這報名過程真的太輕鬆了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Anytime, see you at Room B on Tuesday.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛniˌtaɪm si ju ət ɹum bi ɑn ˈtuzdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 不客氣，週二 B 教室見。

script.youtube_title: 【初學烘焙課🧁】「烘焙是可以吃的科學」報名上課全程聽力🎧｜聽完就會用課程英語💬｜60句沉浸式｜Beginner Baking Class
script.youtube_title_en: "Baking Is Just Science You Can Eat" — Signing Up for a Beginner Baking Class
script.youtube_description:
「烘焙就是可以吃進嘴裡的科學」——想培養一個新嗜好，走進社區廚房報名一堂初學烘焙課，才發現要問的這麼多。這一集是 60 句沉浸式英語聽力練習，場景就在社區廚房的報名櫃檯。

你會聽到：怎麼選初學班、上課時間與費用、自備隔熱手套、圍裙出借、過敏怎麼寫、在哪裡上課、還有每週做完可帶走的烤盤。

整段對話只用 A2 初級單字與美國人日常短句，um、well、so、haha 這些自然語感詞通通都在。

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習，請大聲跟著唸，讓舌頭先學會，腦袋自然就會記住。

不用背，多聽就會用。每天一集，把英文聽成直覺。

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish｜喜歡的話請訂閱並開啟小鈴鐺。
script.youtube_description_en: "Baking is just science you can eat" — you want a new hobby, so you walk into a community kitchen to sign up for a beginner baking class. This is a 60-line immersive English listening practice at the sign-up counter. You will hear how to pick the beginner level, ask about class times and fees, bring your own oven mitts, borrow an apron, note allergies, find the room, and use the make-and-take tray each week. Everything stays in A2-level words with real American small talk: um, well, so, haha. Chapter 4 is a line-by-line listen-and-repeat workout, so speak out loud. No memorizing needed, just listen often and it sticks. #EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish — subscribe for a new scene every day.

script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
想培養一個新的嗜好，走進社區廚房報名烘焙課，才發現從零經驗也能上手？要帶什麼、在哪裡上課、做完的東西能帶回家嗎？

這一集帶大家來到社區廚房的報名櫃檯前，從選班、問時間與費用、自備隔熱手套、出借圍裙、寫下過敏，一路聽到找教室與可帶走的烤盤，共 60 句連續真實對話。

你會聽到：
🧁 選班：Which one, beginner or family?
🧤 自備手套：Just yourself, but bring your own oven mitts.
📍 找教室：Room B, down the hall, second door on the right.
🍪 可帶走：Yep, every week you take home what you bake.

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習：每一句先聽兩遍，再跟著大聲說一遍，把 um、well、so 這些自然語感唸進直覺裡。🎧

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用背單字、不用學文法，多聽就會用。只要跟著這次報名走一趟，下次自己走進廚房，話就會自然冒出來。

祝你烤出人生第一盤完美的餅乾。
